entries.translation: Jet Ski Safari in Alanya | ALANYA TOUR ORGANIZATIONS

entries.source: Jet Ski Safari in Alanya. Ride across the Mediterranean Sea with 130 HP or 200 HP jet ski options. Daily reservations from 09:00 to 19:00. From €60.
entries.translation: Jet Ski Safari in Alanya. Ride across the Mediterranean Sea with 130 HP or 200 HP jet ski options. Daily reservations from 09:00 to 19:00. From €60.

entries.source: Speed, sea spray and pure Mediterranean adrenaline
entries.translation: Speed, sea spray and pure Mediterranean adrenaline

entries.source: Enjoy an exciting jet ski ride across the clear Mediterranean Sea. Choose 130 HP or 200 HP options, ride individually or as a couple, and follow simple safety instructions from our professional team.
entries.translation: Enjoy an exciting jet ski ride across the clear Mediterranean Sea. Choose 130 HP or 200 HP options, ride individually or as a couple, and follow simple safety instructions from our professional team.

entries.source: Jet Ski Safari is one of the fastest ways to experience the Mediterranean coast of Alanya.
entries.translation: Jet Ski Safari is one of the fastest ways to experience the Mediterranean coast of Alanya.

entries.source: After a short safety briefing, you take control of the jet ski and ride within the designated activity area under the supervision of the water-sports team.
entries.translation: After a short safety briefing, you take control of the jet ski and ride within the designated activity area under the supervision of the water-sports team.

entries.source: No previous jet ski experience is normally required. The team explains acceleration, steering, stopping distance, safe passenger position and the signals used on the water.
entries.translation: No previous jet ski experience is normally required. The team explains acceleration, steering, stopping distance, safe passenger position and the signals used on the water.

entries.source: Choose the available 130 HP or 200 HP option and a 10- or 15-minute session. Final machine allocation, passenger configuration and route depend on operator approval, weather and sea conditions.
entries.translation: Choose the available 130 HP or 200 HP option and a 10- or 15-minute session. Final machine allocation, passenger configuration and route depend on operator approval, weather and sea conditions.

entries.source: Strong acceleration, sea spray and a fast Mediterranean ride.
entries.translation: Strong acceleration, sea spray and a fast Mediterranean ride.

entries.source: Ride alone or with one passenger when the operator approves the configuration.
entries.translation: Ride alone or with one passenger when the operator approves the configuration.

entries.source: Clear controls and a short briefing before entering the activity zone.
entries.translation: Clear controls and a short briefing before entering the activity zone.

entries.source: Choose between the available 130 HP and 200 HP options.

entries.source: Fast jet ski ride in the designated Mediterranean activity area.
entries.translation: Fast jet ski ride in the designated Mediterranean activity area.

entries.translation: Solo riding or one passenger, depending on operator approval.

entries.source: The sequence remains the same, while exact timing and route may change because of transfer logistics, machine availability, wind, waves and the operator’s safety decision.
entries.translation: The sequence remains the same, while exact timing and route may change because of transfer logistics, machine availability, wind, waves and the operator’s safety decision.

entries.source: Use the confirmed transfer service or arrive directly at the water-sports point according to your booking details.
entries.translation: Use the confirmed transfer service or arrive directly at the water-sports point according to your booking details.

entries.translation: Ride for the selected 10 or 15 minutes inside the operator’s designated activity area.

entries.source: Do I need previous jet ski experience?
entries.translation: Do I need previous jet ski experience?

entries.source: No previous experience is normally required. You must attend the briefing, demonstrate that you understand the controls and follow the staff instructions throughout the ride.
entries.translation: No previous experience is normally required. You must attend the briefing, demonstrate that you understand the controls and follow the staff instructions throughout the ride.

entries.source: Can two people ride one jet ski?
entries.translation: Can two people ride one jet ski?

entries.source: One passenger may be allowed depending on the selected machine, combined weight, sea conditions and the operator’s final approval.
entries.translation: One passenger may be allowed depending on the selected machine, combined weight, sea conditions and the operator’s final approval.

entries.source: How long is the actual ride?
entries.translation: How long is the actual ride?

entries.source: The booked riding period is 10 or 15 minutes according to the selected tariff. Briefing, equipment preparation and transfer time are separate.
entries.translation: The booked riding period is 10 or 15 minutes according to the selected tariff. Briefing, equipment preparation and transfer time are separate.

entries.source: The activity may be delayed, shortened, rescheduled or cancelled when wind, waves or visibility do not allow safe operation.
entries.translation: The activity may be delayed, shortened, rescheduled or cancelled when wind, waves or visibility do not allow safe operation.

entries.source: What are the age and ID requirements?
entries.translation: What are the age and ID requirements?

entries.source: The operator confirms the minimum driver age, passenger age, identification requirements and any local restrictions before booking. Minors may require a parent or legal guardian.
entries.translation: The operator confirms the minimum driver age, passenger age, identification requirements and any local restrictions before booking. Minors may require a parent or legal guardian.

entries.source: Transfer is included only for the confirmed service zone and booking option. Availability and any extra charge for other areas are confirmed before payment.
entries.translation: Transfer is included only for the confirmed service zone and booking option. Availability and any extra charge for other areas are confirmed before payment.

entries.source: Contact us on WhatsApp — we will help you choose the best jet ski option, ride duration, departure time and transfer details.
